title: MCP Fundamentals: Stateless Requests and JSON-RPC

questions.question: What creates protocol state between two MCP 2026-07-28 requests?
questions.explanation: The modern protocol core is stateless. Each request carries its own version and capabilities.

questions.question: Which two params._meta fields are required on every modern request?
questions.explanation: Protocol version and client capabilities are required. Client identity is recommended.

questions.question: What method must every modern MCP server implement for up-front discovery?
questions.explanation: server/discover advertises supported versions, capabilities, instructions, and server identity.

questions.question: What does error code -32022 mean?
questions.explanation: UnsupportedProtocolVersionError includes the requested version and the versions the server supports.

questions.question: Which result requires ttlMs and cacheScope in MCP 2026-07-28?
questions.explanation: List results and resources/read are cacheable results with required cache hints.

questions.question: How should a server choose capabilities for the current request?
options: Read them from the current request metadata
questions.explanation: A server must not infer modern capabilities from connection or previous-request state.
